entities.summary: The 2012 Pernik earthquake was a 5.6 Mw magnitude earthquake, which struck 24 km west of Bulgaria's capital Sofia and 9 km north-northwest of the provincial center Pernik on 22 May 2012 at 3:00 am local time at a depth of 9.4 kilometers (5.8 mi).
